worksites.prompt: Production sprite atlas for a hand-painted cozy Japanese fantasy RPG. Exactly three equal square cells in a single horizontal row on genuine transparent alpha background. NO characters, NO text, NO frame dividers, NO treasure chests. Cell 1: low lush cushion of fresh green wetland moss, tiny fern fronds and clover-like moss leaves, a little dark soil, no flowers, simple organic readable silhouette. Cell 2: small overgrown ancient stone drainage channel outlet, three irregular gray stones around a dark opening, thin shallow trickle of water, wet moss and a few grasses, isolated prop rather than whole scenery. Cell 3: tidy group of two humble cloth-wrapped parcels tied with brown twine and plain paper delivery tags, one open wicker basket, modest ordinary town delivery supplies. Match detailed clean outlined painted chibi game item sprites with warm natural colors. All three seen from slight top-side view, same ground baseline at 85 percent cell height, full object contained inside own cell with 12 percent transparent margins, no backdrop/ground plane. Designed for compact 65-100px display.
